auth.webSignInShort: Store console is Web-only (accountId + password); you must be in store_staff.
auth.webSignInHint: Sign in with accountId and password. You must be a store_staff member. Clerk player login is not used here.
auth.signInHint: Sign in with your Web account (store_staff membership required).

home.title: Store console
home.subtitle: Your store homepage, in-store posters, optional play-to-win coupons, and staff redeem — no POS change to start.
home.gettingStartedSteps: 1) Publish a poster campaign on your store homepage · 2) Add a game challenge when you want a burst · 3) Staff redeem from the Redeem tab
home.homepageLink: Store homepage (share this link on menus, receipts, social)
home.name: Name

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.intro: Live campaigns appear on your store homepage (/cc/{{partnerSlug}}). Use poster display for everyday promos; add game challenges when you want play-to-win coupons.
campaigns.newHint: Pick a coupon definition below. Create templates under Coupon defs first.
campaigns.offlineForEdit: Move to draft to edit all fields
campaigns.posterBeforeLive: Upload a portrait poster in Edit before going live.
campaigns.settledCannotRelive: Rewards settled: cannot edit or go live again. You can hide it from the landing page.
campaigns.displayTypeHint: Poster display campaign — carousel + CTA only, no Portal join.

form.posterDualHint: Upload separate portrait and landscape posters for best full-screen display. Same theme, different compositions — do not crop one image.
form.posterRequiredHint: Portrait required before going live; landscape strongly recommended.
form.posterDraftHint: You can create a draft first and upload the poster before going live.
form.title: Title
form.rewardModelPass: Per-run · coupon each qualifying run / place
form.rewardModelCompetitive: Points ranking · coupons by final points leaderboard
form.liveLockedHint: Live campaign: only title and description are editable. Move to draft to change rules or schedule.
form.livePosterHint: You can upload or replace posters while live. Move to draft to change rules or schedule.
form.noCouponDefs: No coupon definitions yet. Create one under Coupon defs.
form.maxPlaysPerDay: Max tables per player per day (blank = unlimited)
form.dailyQuotaHint: Daily plays are counted from Portal open-table records (ops day rolls at 05:00). Separate from coupon cap.
form.replaySectionHint: Blank / “Inherit partner” keeps the platform Partner baseline; only fill fields you want to change. Snapshotted at join; in-flight runs are unaffected.
form.rankSoloHint: Each run adds +3 on pass or −1 on fail; coupons by final points board when the campaign ends.
form.rankMultiHint: Each match adds 5/3/1/−1/−2 by place; coupons by final points board when the campaign ends.
form.passSoloHint: Solo: coupon when this run passes / meets the score rule.
form.passMultiHint: Multi: coupon by this match place (tiers for ranks 1–5).
form.passSoloTemplate: Pass mode uses solo P75 template:

couponDefs.title: Coupon definitions
couponDefs.intro: Maintain coupon templates, usage rules, and post-claim validity. Campaigns reference a definition; issued coupons snapshot reward copy and expiry.
couponDefs.usageRulesPlaceholder: e.g. In-store only; cannot combine with other offers (optional)
couponDefs.usageRulesHint: Optional. Shown on the coupon definition details when set.
couponDefs.validityHoursHint: Counted from activation time. Default 72 hours. Also applies to settlement rewards.
couponDefs.activationDelay: Active after a delay from claim
couponDefs.activationHint: Default is immediate. Or delay N hours after claim, or set a calendar time. The redeem window starts at activation.

coupons.title: Issued coupons
coupons.recent200: Showing latest 200 coupons for this merchant

redeem.title: Redeem coupon
redeem.pickStoreHint: You belong to multiple stores — pick which store is redeeming.
redeem.signInRequired: Sign in with your store Web account before redeeming.
redeem.noStores: No stores linked. Ask a Partner admin to add you as store_staff.

team.title: Team members
team.intro: Manage who can access this store console (store_staff). Owners can add Web login accounts with the staff role.
team.merchantRequired: Open team management from a store on the home page.
team.addHint: Enter accountId and password; a Web login identity is created and added as staff.
team.viewerHint: Only owners can manage team members.

rewardLabel.hint: Describe what can be redeemed in store. Staff redeem manually from this copy.
